problem.title: Clinic Appointment Booking API
problem.description: Build a MongoDB-backed REST API for a clinic. Implement POST /appointments to create an appointment with patientName, doctorName, slotTime, and status (default: scheduled). Implement GET /appointments/:id to fetch by ObjectId. Implement PATCH /appointments/:id/status to update status to confirmed or cancelled. Implement GET /health. Return 404 when appointment is not found.
